title: Chancellor Palpatine
subtitle: How Liberty Dies
text: Action [1 resource, Exhaust]: Search the top 5 cards of your deck for a card with Plot, reveal it, and draw it. (Put the other cards on the bottom of your deck in a random order.)
deployBox: When Deployed: The next card you play using Plot this phase costs 3 resources less.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 7 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules:
The cost discount from Palpatine's “When Deployed” ability remains active even if he is defeated before you play a card using Plot.
After searching, put any cards not chosen on the bottom of your deck in a random order.
